item.title: PUSD board endorses initial layoff plan totaling over $5 million in budget cuts
item.description: The Pleasanton school approved a list of over $5 million in budget reductions last week, jobs that trustees said they did not want to see on the chopping block but had to put there so staff can use it as a contingency plan in case other cutbacks the district previously identified fall through during negotiations with labor unions. The post PUSD board endorses initial layoff plan totaling over $5 million in budget cuts appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
